headline: Why Wall Street Prices Coca-Cola and PepsiCo Differently
summary: Warren Buffett once said his favorite holding period is “forever,” and he was probably talking about Coca-Cola (NYSE:KO) when he said it. headline: Is FEMSA Stock Worth Buying Now as Growth Meets a Premium Valuation?
summary: FEMSA's retail and digital growth strengthens its long-term case, but a premium valuation and weak international margins suggest patience.

headline: PepsiCo launches Alvalle gazpacho in the U.S., expanding into refrigerated foods
summary: PepsiCo today announced the U.S. launch of Alvalle gazpacho, a ready-to-eat refrigerated soup made with vegetables and extra-virgin olive oil. The introduction marks a continued step in the company's expansion into fresh, meal-adjacent foods and the growing chilled category.

headline: Convenience store giant takes on Coca-Cola and Pepsi
summary: As the two best-known cola manufacturers, Coca-Cola and PepsiCo have been locked in a struggle for decades.
